_comment: FFmpeg @ 1019f8f036 (the c/ submodule) prebuilds for crustify campaign 20261005. FFmpeg has no configure switch for deprecated APIs (FF_API_* is hard-defined in version_major.h), so deprecated items are excluded at schedule time, not here. --disable-autodetect keeps the build hermetic; platform/vendor hwcontext backends are out of scope. tsan is kept separate from asan-ubsan (conflicting runtimes); bsan builds the C with the bsan toolchain's matched clang and pass plugin; its runtime is linked once, into executables only, and exported (-rdynamic) to the libraries, which leave __bsan_* undefined. The bsan runtime (bsan 0.1.0, 3f210d63ae) reports a false use-after-free when realloc(NULL, n) runs in a non-inlined function and its result is later freed; av_realloc hits it in the instrumented C executables (ffmpeg, FATE tools), which abort. Rust test binaries under cargo bsan (CRUSTIFY_BUILD_VARIANT=bsan, then named CRUSTIFY_FFMPEG_VARIANT) run clean against it, av_realloc(NULL, n) paths included. Version 4: the C moved to c/, so each variant configures ../../../c/configure, and build_commands run from c/.
